01Claude Code and chats

These rows cover setup, sending and stopping, history and search, notices and figures, and custom model connections.

Warning

Archive, pin and bookmarks do not preserve a transcript that Claude Code cleans up. Export important conversations before the CLI's retention period.

SituationWhat to expect
Signing in on Linux when neither xdg-terminal-exec nor x-terminal-emulator is installedVIKI Agent can't open a sign-in console. Run claude auth login in a terminal instead.
VIKI Agent opened from Finder, the Dock or a desktop menu (macOS or Linux)It adds ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /opt/homebrew/sbin and /usr/local/bin to its PATH when they exist and are not on it. It does not run your shell, so a folder that only your shell's startup files add, such as a version manager's, is missing for saved checks and for Claude Code's MCP servers and hooks. Start VIKI Agent from a terminal to keep that PATH.
Claude Code is installed, or moved, while VIKI Agent is openVIKI Agent keeps using what it found at launch. Restart it to find the new installation.
macOS and Linux: VIKI Agent is killed or crashes while Magpie is runningMagpie can keep running until VIKI Agent starts again, which stops it. If Open Magpie reports its ports in use before that, quit the magpie process that holds 3426 and 3431.
Installing Claude Code plugins through Open CapabilitiesThis view lists observed plugins only. Magpie manages its own plugins in its dashboard.
A brand-new chat is stopped before Claude Code records its first turnA later send can report that the conversation record was not found. Start a new session and recover any unsent text from Drafts and send history.
A background agent's Stop is pressedAn older Claude Code build may stop other runs in that chat as well. A still-open permission card can remain until answered or the process ends.
A request mixes right-to-left letters, such as Arabic or Hebrew, with digits or punctuationPermission cards show hidden characters as codes, but right-to-left letters still follow the usual display rules, so such a command can be drawn in a different order from the one it runs in. The zero-width joiners that Persian and Indic text use are also shown as codes.
Two single clicks land on Allow once or Deny in the chat or Approvals as cards move upThe second click of a double-click is ignored, but two separate clicks each answer the card under the pointer. Read the card before the second click.
A waiting Steer messageIt can't be taken back. Stop runs it next. Send another message to change course.
Closing the chat while a Steer message is still waitingThe message shows as not sent, but Claude Code may still start it. Let the waiting rows clear before you close the chat.
The window changes size while text is in the message boxThe message box can keep its old height until the next keystroke.
A chat or search says history is partialLarge transcripts and bounded searches can omit older content. Open the original transcript or narrow the search before concluding content is absent.
Search sessions doesn't find a message Claude read mid-replyIt shows in the conversation.
Several windows are openEach window can raise its own agent or routine desktop notification. So a notice may appear more than once.
Context or plan-limit figures are absent or staleFigures appear only when Claude Code reports them. Context updates after a reply ends. A new process can show the previous trigger until its own first reply completes.
A custom model connection fails or is interruptedThe chat sends no more requests until you close and reopen it. Fix the connection, then close and reopen the chat to retry.
A custom connection encounters a native tool-search resultChat Completions and Responses connections cannot translate native tool-reference blocks. Start a chat with an Anthropic Messages connection for those results.
Signing in through Magpie inside the desktop appSome sign-in flows show a popup-blocked notice even after the sign-in page opens in your system browser. Continue in that browser and return to Magpie; it keeps checking for completion.

02Vault notes and app data

These rows cover where a vault folder may live, direct note Save and note actions on macOS or Linux, a deny rule in some Start with VIKI vaults, and opening the app data with an older build.

SituationWhat to expect
A vault folder inside a cloud-synced folderWindows refuses the OneDrive folders only. macOS refuses iCloud Drive (~/Library/Mobile Documents) and ~/Library/CloudStorage, and the rest of ~/Library as a system folder. Linux refuses no folder by name for being cloud-synced. Keep the vault outside any synced folder.
Direct note Save or note actions in a vault on another drive, such as a network drive (macOS or Linux)The vault stays read-only.
Direct note Save or note actions in a vault on a drive that isn't NTFS, such as an exFAT USB drive (Windows)The vault stays read-only, and the app says the vault's drive doesn't support saving notes.
Direct note Save or a note action that replaces a note (macOS or Linux)The replace does not keep extended attributes or Finder tags.
A note save that collides with another program's save (macOS or Linux)With no file lock from the OS, the save keeps that program's version and says the note changed. A new note's save can wait in recovery instead.
Another program keeps the note open for writing during a saveOn macOS or Linux, with no file lock from the OS, that program can lose its own later write. On Windows, the save is refused while another program holds the note open for writing.
A vault that uses Git LFS or another Git filterThe status bar's Git chip counts a filtered file as changed when its timestamps changed but its contents did not, for example after the vault was copied. Running git status in the vault yourself clears it.
An Ordinary vault whose AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md comes to hold the same text as a protected vault's file of that nameSaving that text in Settings › Instructions and Persona is refused. Another program's edit, a protected vault's file that changed since VIKI Agent last read it, or a vault made protected later can still bring the files into line; VIKI Agent then refuses every save to this vault. Change the file outside VIKI Agent so the two differ.
A Start with VIKI vault whose .claude/settings.json denies Edit(_raw/**)Claude Code applies that rule to new files too, so /learn and the researcher can't save originals into _raw/. Delete that line from the vault's .claude/settings.json. _raw/ stays create-only through the first prime directive in the vault's AGENTS.md.
Updating VIKI AgentEach update step to app.sqlite3 leaves a verified copy of the store beside it. VIKI Agent deletes none of them. So an update that crosses several store versions leaves one such copy for each step in the app's data folder.
Opening the app data with an older buildThe older build refuses it. Rolling back to the copy made before the update loses what the app stored after it, such as saved settings. See Rolling back after an upgrade.

03Code folders

These rows cover saving and Git in code folders, managing folders and previews, and worktrees.

Saving and Git

SituationWhat to expect
A code folder on another drive, such as a network drive (macOS or Linux)It is not supported for Save, commit, integrate, push and worktrees.
A code folder on a drive that isn't NTFS (Windows)It is not supported for Save, commit, integrate, push and worktrees.
A save that collides with another program's write (macOS or Linux)With no file lock from the OS, the save keeps that program's version and says the file changed elsewhere.
Another program keeps the file open for writing during a saveOn macOS or Linux, with no file lock from the OS, that program can lose its own later write. On Windows, the save is refused with "Another app is using this file." instead.
A save that replaces a file (macOS or Linux)The replace keeps the mode bits, the executable bit included. It keeps the group where the account may, else it drops group access. It drops xattrs, Finder tags, ACLs and the creation date.
A file with no owner write, another user's file, or a file with a macOS uchg or uappnd flag (macOS or Linux)The save says the file is read-only or locked.
A file name that breaks the Win32 name rules (every OS)The Win32 name rules apply on every OS. So a Linux file named a?b.txt shows in the folder tree but cannot be saved.
A code file name part over 255 UTF-8 bytes (macOS or Linux)It is refused.
Hooks (macOS or Linux)Hooks run as Git runs them.

Folders, previews and the picker

SituationWhat to expect
Removing a code folder that still has a worktreeVIKI Agent refuses until every worktree under it is removed in the Code view first.
Removing a code folder while its preview is runningThe preview keeps running, and the Code view can no longer list or stop it. It stops when VIKI Agent closes. Stop a folder's preview before you remove the folder.
Unticking a folder in Settings while a chat is using itThe open chat keeps its folders until its process stops. The new tick set applies once it restarts or a new chat opens.
The folder picker (Browse…) is left openOn Windows it has no timeout, so closing VIKI Agent waits until the picker closes. Off Windows, the picker program is stopped after 600 seconds.

Worktrees and cleanup

SituationWhat to expect
Inspecting a chat's worktree in the Code sidebarThe sidebar browses the selected registered code folder. It does not automatically follow the chat's session worktree. The worktree's files can differ from the registered folder's files.
Restoring an archived worktreeA restored file comes back with the line endings a checkout writes. So a file whose endings differed from that comes back converted.
git push --mirror on a trusted code folderIt also sends refs/viki/archive/*, worktree cleanup's archive refs, to the remote.
An editor or dev server has an idle worktree's folder openWatching the folder for changes does not keep it from cleanup. Only a process whose working folder or an open file is inside the worktree does.
Worktree cleanup can't tell whether a program is using an idle worktreeIt keeps the worktree, and the Worktrees tab says "A program has a file or folder open inside it."
A worktree whose open-program check cannot finish (macOS)VIKI keeps it when its folder or the system's open-file query cannot be read.
A Bot chat that started before its Bot had a code folder, and a Bot's routine runIt gets no copy.
A Bot code copy's first sendIt takes longer while the copy is made. It waits up to 10 seconds for VIKI Agent's other work in that folder. VIKI Agent keeps at most 32 worktrees, so a 33rd copy is refused until you remove one in the Worktrees tab.
Git settings of a folder that has had a Bot copy changeAny change does it, including an ordinary git push -u, a branch that sets upstream tracking, a changed remote or git config for your name or e-mail, run by you or by Claude Code in the copy. VIKI Agent's own Git actions on that folder and its worktrees refuse, and the status bar's Git chip shows an unknown status, until you undo the change or select Confirm the current settings in the Worktrees tab. The check goes on after the last copy is removed, until you remove the folder from the list. See Bot code copies for the limits that remain.
A Bot whose code folder's hooks folder holds a subfolder or a hard-linked file (the layout of husky 5 to 8)Every first message answers "VIKI Agent can't read this folder's Git settings safely." and no copy is made. Change the hooks layout, or clear the Bot's code folder in Bot settings.
A released Bot copy cleanup can't handle safelyIt stays on disk, marked Released in the Worktrees tab, and counts toward the 32-worktree limit until you remove it. This happens, for example, with a submodule, a switched branch, a merge in progress, or a changed file under a Git filter other than Git LFS. See Worktree cleanup to remove one.
A Bot copy in a folder whose Git filter rewrites files on checkout (not Git LFS)The Code view can list unchanged files as changed, and Remove then reports changes. Running git status in the copy yourself clears it.
Restoring an archived Bot copy that holds Git LFS filesA file whose object is not in the repository's own LFS store comes back as its pointer file. Nothing is downloaded.
Commit in a Bot copy when commits are signed by a program named by a relative pathVIKI Agent does not start that program there, so Commit is refused.
A worktree not made by VIKI AgentCleanup sweeps, archives and offers Restore only for the worktrees VIKI made in its own area.
A worktree recorded from before VIKI Agent's data folder last movedRestoring it from the Worktrees tab is refused, since its folder no longer sits in the current data area. Restore it with Git by hand.

04VIKI's launcher and Decision

These rows cover the chats, runs, drafts and items VIKI starts or offers on its own. The Decision guide explains each setting these rows name.

What VIKI starts on its own

SituationWhat to expect
Letting VIKI prepare drafts, start chats or start BotsVIKI starts a Bot only through its own tested routine, under Start Bots' work. Apart from the notice of a Bot whose delivery you turned on, it does not message other chats or people or send to your phone.
Right after VIKI Agent startsVIKI starts no chat, Bot run or inbox suggestion run of its own until Claude Code first reports your plan use. This applies whatever Pause automatic starts at Claude plan usage says. Your own starts and saved checks are not held.
After Stop allVIKI starts no chat or Bot run of its own for one check interval. What still waits starts at the check after that.
A chat VIKI started that finished without your answerVIKI closes it once it finishes, fails or reaches its time limit while you have answered none of its cards. It closes even while you are looking at it. Select it in your session list to reopen it from its transcript.
Stopping a chat VIKI startedVIKI does not start work for that item again on its own, even after the item changes.
Delete all decision history after marking items Not usefulThose items can come back, and VIKI may start their work again. A kind you turned off with Stop these stays off.
A second look or a project plan still open when you use Delete all decision historyIf VIKI Agent closes before it ends, the next start lists it as a chat VIKI started that has finished.
Deleting a suggestion you marked Not usefulIt can come back as a new suggestion, and VIKI may start its work again.
Deleting suggestions during the dayThey leave today's message draft, saved check and inbox suggestion counts, so more may come that day.
Chats VIKI startedData cannot delete them. Their transcripts stay in Claude Code.

After Delete all decision history during a day, what VIKI already started or raised that day counts like this:

Started or raised that dayWhat changes
Chats for Look on my behalfThey count toward Daily limit: drafts instead of Daily limit: looks VIKI starts, until the next day.
Chats for Take a second look at my workThey count toward Daily limit: drafts instead of Daily limit: second looks VIKI starts, until the next day.
Chats for Plan next steps for my projectsThey count toward Daily limit: drafts instead of Daily limit: project plans VIKI starts, until the next day.
Message draftsTheir counts are freed from Daily limit: message drafts.
New commits for Run my saved checksTheir counts are freed from Daily limit: new commits VIKI checks.
Inbox statesTheir counts are freed from Daily limit: inbox suggestion items.

Bots and Kanban

SituationWhat to expect
A saved Bot thread reopens with no replyNative history can show the same records after an empty reply or after reply records were removed. Open its Bot chat to inspect the available history before continuing.
A Bot is removed or Bots are reset while the app window is openThe Bot's chats show in the ordinary chat list again after the window reloads.
A Bot task thread beyond the newest 50It opens with its Bot's header when the chat's saved Bot identity names that Bot. In a vault whose policy is not Ordinary it still opens as a profile chat, and for a Bot with more than 50 threads a routine run's chat opens with the header reading Task thread.
A Bot pins a model connection and the connection is removed or unreadableThe Bot's chats refuse to start; there is no fallback to your Claude Code sign-in. Routine runs use the native default.
Cards in a vault synced from another computerVIKI tells your cards from a Bot's by the card file's change time, which a sync can move. So it may offer Start where it would have started a Bot, or start one for a card a Bot wrote.
A todo card synced in after a Bot's run with an older file timeIt gets no start or Start offer until it changes again.
Stop on a Bot run VIKI just startedWhile Claude Code is still starting, Stop can miss the run. Press it again once the run's session shows.
Stopping a Bot run VIKI startedWith Start Bots' work set to Allowed, VIKI starts that seat again on its own only once you add or change one of its todo cards. Run now and the routine's own times still run it.
A team with thousands of Bot runs and chats VIKI startedA todo card older than the newest 5,000 of them counts as possibly a Bot's. A card a Bot wrote during its run counts the same way.
A card whose title: text has a comma, colon or quote, or whose tags are listed on the lines below tags:VIKI reads only simple front matter, so such a card can be left unread. VIKI does not count an unread card, and a routine set to Only when a card is waiting runs its time as usual. Put the title in the card's # heading and keep tags: on one line, as /kanban and the card template do.
Cards kept in a folder other than kanban/They don't show or count until you move them into kanban/, or ask a chat in that vault to.
Core team says "This vault has no Kanban skill"A vault can lack .claude/skills/kanban/, or hold its card skill under another name. Copy .claude/skills/kanban/ from a new Start with VIKI vault, as the Help topic's "Add Kanban to a vault you already have" describes, then choose Refresh Bots.
Never send folder rules and cards in kanban/A folder rule covers a card only if it names kanban/.
A bookmark to a card you movedIt shows as missing.
A note moved or synced into a folder a routine waits onA routine set to Only when a note changed goes by each note's file time. A move or a sync can keep that time older than the routine's last run, so the routine's next time can be skipped. Edit the note, or use Run now.
A Bot that writes a new finished card each run, without moving the todo card it was started forVIKI counts any of a Bot's cards that is not todo and changed during its run as progress. So the Bot can be started again, up to Daily limit: Bot runs VIKI starts.

Vault, chats and bridges

SituationWhat to expect
A memory whose cited note was only rewrittenVIKI compares a cited note's change time with when you approved the memory. So a sync or tool that rewrites the file unchanged lists the memory too.
A Bot's memory kept in VIKI Agent's data folderIt is not part of vault backups. After a vault's policy changes, the Bot's earlier memory folder is not used.
A message VIKI lists as possibly not arrivedThe item stays after you check the chat. Mark it Not useful to clear it.
An MCP server item after you turned the server offVIKI reads the chat's last context reading, which updates when that chat finishes a reply. So the item stays until the chat's next reply.

Looks at code folders

SituationWhat to expect
A code folder whose uncommitted changes you keep on purposeVIKI looks at each state of those changes once. Set Look on my behalf to Ask first or Off to stop these chats.
A code folder with only new, untracked filesVIKI checks changes to files Git already tracks, so such a folder gets no look.
A launch whose active workspace is a code folderVIKI checks code folders for Look on my behalf only while a vault is the active workspace.
A code folder's look item that closes and comes backVIKI lists a code folder only from a check in the last half hour that found its changes idle for a day. It checks one folder at a time. So an item can close until that folder's next check. This can happen after VIKI Agent starts, after a failed check, or with more trusted folders than checks in half an hour.
A code folder that uses Git LFS or another Git filterVIKI's check runs git status there, as the Code tab does. So the folder's own Git filters run and may update their cache under .git. In a Bot copy, only Git LFS's own commands run.
A trusted code folder whose .claude settings or .mcp.json change after you trusted itChats there, VIKI's looks included, run the new hooks and servers without asking again. Set Look on my behalf to Ask first to start every look yourself.

Second looks and project plans

SituationWhat to expect
A long task in a chat you are not looking atVIKI takes a second look only at the chat open in front of you, when its last reply finishes.
A reply that changed files that are not notes, or changed notes with shell commandsA second look starts only when the reply edited notes in the vault with Claude Code's edit tools.
A chat in a code folder, an agent's chat or a Bot's runThese get no second look.
A long or corrected chatEach later reply that edits notes can get its own second look, up to Daily limit: second looks VIKI starts. Set Take a second look at my work to Ask first or Off to stop them.
A second look with Never send foldersIts message leaves out the notes under a held folder. No second look starts when every note it would name is held, though its item can still show.
A second look in a vault kept in GitThe chat reads git status and git diff, which can show changes under a held folder.
A second look with a Never send tagThe tag is not judged there.
A second look or a project plan you leave unansweredIts chat stays open until you answer the plan or select Stop. While it is open, VIKI starts no other chat of its own. Your own start can still use the second place.
A second look or a project plan that keeps failingEach failed start shows a Report that notifies you, up to that kind's daily limit. Set its grant to Ask first or Off to stop them.
Stopping second looks or project plansLearning counts a stopped one as started only, not as turned down. So stopping them does not pause that kind. Set its grant to Ask first or Off.
Changing the mode of a second look or a project plan yourselfVIKI counts a plan as approved when its chat leaves plan mode after you answer it. So a mode you pick by hand there counts too.
Closing VIKI Agent's window while a second look or a project plan waitsVIKI Agent answers that plan with Keep planning as the chat closes. Learning can count that second look or project plan as turned down.
An overdue task while Prepare drafts and Plan next steps for my projects are both onOne overdue task can get a chat that plans its work and another that checks whether it is done.
A vault VIKI cannot list in full, such as one with more than 5,000 notesVIKI cannot tell when a project last changed, so it starts no plan for a stalled project there.
More than eight active projectsVIKI reads the eight active projects whose overview note changed most recently. So an older stalled project may get no plan.
Overdue tasks in more than three projectsVIKI looks at the three most overdue tasks it finds, so it checks at most three projects' tasks at a time. The others come up once those tasks are ticked or given new dates.
A note or task line in a project that Never send holds back by a tagVIKI can still start a plan for that project. Its chat can read that note, as your own chat can. Never send holds the plan back only for a held folder inside the project or a held task VIKI lists.
Several stalled projects or sets of overdue tasks at onceVIKI starts one chat of its own at a time, in any vault. The next comes at a later check, once you answer or stop the first.

Message drafts

SituationWhat to expect
A chat that is not open in front of you, or not your ownVIKI offers message drafts only for the chat you have open, while a vault whose policy is Ordinary or Protected is active. It offers none for VIKI's chat, a chat VIKI started, a routine run, a Bot's or an agent's chat, or a chat in a code folder.
Prepare drafts set to OffVIKI then offers no message drafts either.
A message draft you select but do not sendLearning counts a message draft as used once you select its button, sent or not.
A message draft VIKI decides not to show youIt still counts toward Daily limit: message drafts that day.
A chat Claude Code compacts on its ownVIKI offers a handoff once Claude Code reports the chat 70% full or more at the end of a reply. A chat compacted before that gets none.
A literature-note draft you sendIt asks Claude Code to write a note for each page in the vault you have open, a protected vault included, under your own permission prompts. It also asks Claude Code to show you each note and wait for your go-ahead first, but VIKI itself holds no write back.
A literature-note draft, under a permission mode that accepts editsNo prompt stops a write.

Saved checks

Warning

With Run my saved checks set to Allowed, VIKI runs every saved check you have run in a trusted folder when the folder moves to a new commit. If a saved check changes anything outside its folder, such as a deploy, keep that command out of saved checks, or keep the grant on Ask first.

SituationWhat to expect
Preview commands on macOS and LinuxPreviews run on Windows only. Checks and the terminal are available on all three OSes.
Saved checks in a worktreeRun my saved checks looks only at a trusted folder's own checkout, not its worktrees.
A new commit that changes a folder's own scripts, such as after a pullWith Run my saved checks set to Allowed, a saved check runs those changed scripts without asking. Keep the grant on Ask first to look first.
A check that makes a commit or moves the branchEach commit it makes is a new commit for Run my saved checks. So VIKI can run the checks again, up to Daily limit: new commits VIKI checks a day.
A check run VIKI started, in the Checks tabIt looks like a run you started. Only its item in VIKI's launcher tells them apart. Stop there or Stop all cancels it while VIKI Agent stays open.
A saved-check item after Stop or Stop all, under AllowedThe item can keep saying VIKI can run the checks, though VIKI starts none on that commit while VIKI Agent stays open. Run them from the Checks tab, or set Run my saved checks to Ask first for Run checks.
A commit VIKI had not begun to check before Stop or Stop all, under AllowedIt can still start later.
Run checks says the checks are already runningIt says so whenever none of the checks could start, also when one cannot start at all. The Checks tab shows why.
A saved-check item that still says its checks are runningVIKI looks at one folder each time it checks, and at each folder at most every five minutes. So the item can trail the Checks tab by five minutes or more. With many folders, or when VIKI checks less often, it can trail by about one check's interval for each folder.
A saved check you run many more times, such as in a worktreeVIKI judges a commit by each check's most recent kept runs. So after many later runs of the same check, it can offer or run that check again on a commit it already checked.

Inbox suggestions

SituationWhat to expect
An inbox suggestion run VIKI startedIt is the run Ask VIKI to suggest starts. It sends your captures' names and opening text to Claude without a click, and denies any permission it asks for. Set Suggest destinations for my inbox to Ask first to start it yourself, or to Off.
A suggestion run VIKI startsIt shows no Started by VIKI chip. Stop and Stop all do not reach it. It reads only and ends by itself within five minutes.
A suggestion run going when VIKI Agent closesAfter the restart it shows as failed, and VIKI does not run the suggestions again for that inbox until a capture is added or changed. Ask VIKI to suggest in the triage runs them again.
Suggest destinations just after the inbox changedWhen a capture was added, changed or filed since VIKI last checked, the run sends nothing. The launcher says VIKI couldn't ask for those suggestions. The next check raises the new inbox, or use Ask VIKI to suggest in the triage.
A capture moved or synced into 00-inbox/When its file time is older than VIKI's last suggestion run, VIKI raises no inbox suggestion item for it until a capture gets a newer change. Ask VIKI to suggest in the triage runs it.
A capture added while VIKI suggestsThe item for the earlier inbox closes. VIKI raises the new inbox ten minutes after its newest capture changed. It comes as a new state that counts toward Daily limit: inbox suggestion items.
A capture a suggestion run left without a destinationVIKI does not run the suggestions again for it until a capture in 00-inbox/ is added or changed. Ask VIKI to suggest in the triage runs them again.
An inbox suggestion item that still says VIKI is suggestingVIKI sees that the run ended at its next check. So the item can trail Triage inbox by one check.
Any tag, a folder over a capture in 00-inbox/, or a folder in 10-projects/ on Never sendVIKI raises no inbox suggestion item and starts no run. Ask VIKI to suggest in the triage still runs it.
Triaging from the inbox tile or the Vault overviewLearning counts an inbox suggestion item as used only when you select its own Triage inbox or Suggest destinations, or Useful. An item you leave unanswered counts toward neither.

05Messaging

Messaging supports optional Mattermost, Slack and Discord bridges.

SituationWhat to expect
Choosing a messaging providerOther messaging providers are unavailable. Other server or workspace versions, mobile apps, Mattermost reactions, typing and the edited status reply, and installing the Discord app are untested.
A messaging connection stops or requests renewalThe bot says why in its chat when it can. After cleanup and any cooldown, turn it on again with the switch beside its status in Messaging. If the card says to restart VIKI Agent, restart it before connecting again. The bridge does not reconnect automatically or replay offline messages.
Editing or deleting a Mattermost message right after sending itBefore the bot has read the message back from Mattermost, this can stop the bot. The bot then says why in the chat. Send a new message instead of editing.
Bot routine notices through Slack or DiscordNamed Bot routine notices are Mattermost-only, with their separate consent for each launch.

06Voice

Voice is optional, and it is less tested outside Windows. Test your microphone and installed voice before depending on it.

SituationWhat to expect
Optional voice on a new machineDictation may take longer on first start, especially when a GPU driver builds its cache.
Choosing Natural voices as the speech engineNatural voices need Windows x64, an NVIDIA graphics card with 4 GB of memory and driver 570.65 or later.
Natural voices for Japanese, Korean, German or RussianKokoro does not read them. Qwen3 or the system voice does.
Natural voices through Qwen3 on a laptop graphics cardSpeech can take several times longer than it plays. Settings › Chat shows the speed measured on this PC. It warns when hands-free answers will come from the system voice.
Reading aloud or hands-free speaks through a Voicebox voiceSpeech starts only once Voicebox has made the first sentence. The first reading after Voicebox itself starts also waits for it to load its model. Choose a smaller model size in Settings › Chat if it starts too late.
Reading aloud or hands-free speaks through a natural voiceThe first reading after natural voices start waits for the voice server to start and load its model.
Hands-free speaks through a natural or Voicebox voiceWhen no audio arrives 15 seconds after the reply ends and a system voice speaks the reply's language, the system voice reads that answer. The hands-free strip says so.
The window is covered or minimized during hands-freeThe answer is still read, then hands-free ends instead of reopening the microphone. Covering the window while hands-free is listening ends it at once.
The audio device changes while hands-free speaksThe answer keeps playing on the new default device. A reply's own Read pauses instead.
A card opens while Speak while VIKI writes is reading the final answerThe card stops the early speech. When the turn ends, the answer is read again from its start, so its first sentences can repeat.

07VIKI Agent's own window and installers

These rows cover VIKI Agent's own window and installing an unsigned build.

SituationWhat to expect
Opening a code preview from VIKI Agent's own windowCode previews open in Edge, Chrome or Chromium. Without one of those installed, Preview reports that the browser is missing.
Spellcheck in VIKI Agent's own windowSpellcheck works only on macOS, using the system checker. Windows and Linux show no corrections there.
Opening VIKI Agent's own window on desktop LinuxElectron's sandbox needs its helper binary owned by root at mode 4755. After npm --prefix desktop ci, run once: sudo chown root:root desktop/node_modules/electron/dist/chrome-sandbox and sudo chmod 4755 desktop/node_modules/electron/dist/chrome-sandbox.
Installing an unsigned build on WindowsSmartScreen shows More info, then Run anyway.
Installing an unsigned build on macOSOpen System Settings › Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway. macOS asks for keychain access again after each new unsigned build.

See Using VIKI Agent for the affected controls and Security for the task and permission boundaries.
